sources.description: Original user-provided wordlist, first examples and translations, preserved as an exact backup.

New contextual explanations, corrected readings and translations, second examples and usage notes authored for this project on 2026-10-04. Per-entry references are in the CSV 来源说明 field and curated source files.

sources.title: Mapull Chinese Dictionary
sources.modifications: Same-reading Chinese definitions and contextual memory aids; frozen 1000-idiom selection; literal/modern explanations; independently authored modern examples; machine-assisted translations with review boundaries.
sources.provenanceCaveat: Upstream notes that original provenance of some collected content cannot be established. An attributed reference, not certified authoritative lexicography.

referencePolicy: Definitions from CC-CEDICT and Mapull are selected and attributed. Other cited references verify individual facts. Modern idiom examples are independently authored; translation and pinyin drafts are explicitly labeled. See tools/wordlist_refined/audit.json and tools/idiom_curated/catalog.json for production evidence.
separation: Lexicon content derived from CC-CEDICT retains CC BY-SA 4.0. Stroke geometry retains the separate Arphic Public License. Independent app source code is not relicensed by these data notices.
